verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a public API with a first-request quickstart and an API reference that includes endpoints such as GET /v1/models. It also ships official Python and TypeScript SDKs and exposes features like the Agents API, batching and function calling programmatically, so the product can clearly be driven through a documented public API. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and fuller endpoint-level detail in places (a community report says the OCR endpoint docs lack chunking details).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Programmatic catalog discovery documented in the API reference: "List Models" (`GET /v1/models`) and "Retrieve Model" endpoints.
We provide official SDK clients in both Python and Typescript
AI agents autonomously execute tasks using LLMs, with tools, state persistence, and multi-agent collaboration via the Agents API
